name: @tssae/adapters
description: Official TSSAE library adapters for Zod and Drizzle ORM.

scripts.format:check: oxfmt --list-different . && cargo fmt --manifest-path native/zod/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path native/drizzle/Cargo.toml --all -- --check
scripts.format:write: oxfmt --write . && cargo fmt --manifest-path native/zod/Cargo.toml --all && cargo fmt --manifest-path native/drizzle/Cargo.toml --all
scripts.lint: oxlint --quiet --format=unix --ignore-pattern node_modules . && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path native/zod/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path native/drizzle/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --pretty false && mkdir -p dist/native dist/zod dist/drizzle && cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path native/zod/Cargo.toml && cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path native/drizzle/Cargo.toml && cp native/zod/target/release/libtssae_adapter_zod.so dist/native/libtssae_adapter_zod.so && cp native/drizzle/target/release/libtssae_adapter_drizzle.so dist/native/libtssae_adapter_drizzle.so && cp native/zod/tssae-native.json dist/zod/tssae-native.json && cp native/drizzle/tssae-native.json dist/drizzle/tssae-native.json
scripts.test: cargo test --locked --manifest-path native/zod/Cargo.toml && cargo test --locked --manifest-path native/drizzle/Cargo.toml && node --conditions=source --test --test-reporter=spec 'test/**/*.test.ts'
